init.title: Sensors, protection and AI planner
init.description: You can also correct the main electrical sensors here. Measured PV is real inverter production; potential PV is the estimate without zero-export curtailment. Current-hour and next-hour forecast fields accept either W or kWh and Casa ES keeps power and energy separate automatically.
